inputs.prompt: A ten-second locked-camera motion-design study for EVA Seed-33 POST-FORMATION overlays. From the very first frame the underlying scene is completely formed and stays stable: a readable warm ochre/umber architectural cafe composition with one human figure, cup, table, chair, window mullions and small warm accent swatches. NO loading, building, dissolving, entrance, camera motion, cuts, morphing subjects or scene reconstruction. Throughout all ten seconds, including the last seconds, show visibly active LOCALIZED unstable image-processing corruption around the person's silhouette and shoulder, cup rim, furniture edges, architectural joints and accent swatches. Combine two interacting layers. RASTER: long horizontal scanline tears using actual subject image rows stretched sideways, thin layered ribbons with occasional thicker displaced image fragments, broken edge silhouettes, repeated contour echoes, clearly visible saturated cyan/magenta/red/green channel separation confined to corrupted edges. TRACKING: very thin outlined rectangles of radically varying sizes/aspect ratios, diagonal Xs in some rectangles, sparse fine straight connectors between box corners and feature anchors. Small and larger crossed boxes form irregular feature-bound clusters which appear, split, resize, drop out and relocate, not merely float or jitter. Use irregular staggered local holds and re-acquisitions with overlapping activity so the scene never settles into static rectangles. Selected raster ribbons shift abruptly while tracking clusters hold briefly then reconfigure; other areas remain legible. Keep localized corruption evident without full-screen flashing, broad brightness oscillation, rapid alternating white/black fields or uncontrolled strobe. Warm scene remains unchanged underneath except bounded temporary sampled-image distortions. No regular cell grid, solid neon boxes, dashboard, text labels, logos or decorative particles. A visual motion reference for live deterministic code, NOT a movie to be played inside the app.

runs.inspection: 500ms overview plus 100ms sequence 4.0–5.1s. Faint nearly static outlines, insufficient image tearing. Not suitable motion guidance. Sampled frames, not full-speed playback.
